pages.text: Snow piled up overnight. Sun reached only the shop steps, melting all their snow.
Gugu wanted to sit on the warm steps and hopped up.
Nono and Kiki came. Gugu stretched out across the steps. "Nobody come here."
Nono and Kiki went to the snowy ground and bounced about together.
Gugu leaned against the steps, enjoying the sun. The steps were roomy and warm.
Laughter kept coming from over there. Gugu stretched their neck to look.
Gugu sat with a hand under their chin. Warm, but no fun at all.
Grandpa Badger asked, "Who will you invite into that roomy place?"
Gugu moved to one side. "Friends, it is warm here. Come and sit."
All three sat side by side on the steps. Sunshine warmed everyone. Gugu laughed loudest.
